value: From a comforting bowl of phở to your favourite wok-tossed classics. A little taste of home, right here in Springvale.

Good food brings people together. At Nam Son, Chinese and Vietnamese favourites find a place at the same table — from fragrant noodle soups to sizzling, savoury classics. Come for a quick lunch, settle in with friends, or take a little comfort home.
